summary: Bump the changelog-derived project version from 0.4.6 to 0.4.7 and put the BUG-0541 and BUG-0542 fixes under the new heading. API impact: none — no operation is introduced, so no x-introduced-version stamp moves.

guide.reason: Working-version stamps on install, updates, publish and pool guide pages move to 0.4.7. Operator workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: The 0.4.7 fixes change behaviour behind existing operations (documented in their own change record); no operation is introduced, so the generated API reference keeps its version stamps.

roadmap.reason: Release metadata only; phase gates unchanged.

state.reason: No durable product setting or resource is introduced.

verification.method: python3 scripts/release-version.py --current --format both returns 0.4.7 0.4.7; python3 -m unittest tests.test_release_version; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_repository_privacy.py.
